arguments.Prompt: A tangent-space normal map of the exact character in Reference-1.png, pixel-aligned to it with the exact same framing, silhouette, scale, and pose. Standard OpenGL tangent space normal map coloring: flat surfaces facing directly toward the camera/viewer are #8080FF lavender blue, surfaces tilted right are reddish/pink, surfaces tilted left are cyan/green-blue, surfaces tilted upward are greenish, surfaces tilted downward are purple/violet. Smooth, continuous 3D volume normal map rendering capturing the relief, curved geometry, and sculpted forms of the face, cowl/hood, drapery and folds of the robes, wooden staff, and hands. No specular highlights, no diffuse lighting, no shadows, no outlines, no text. The background outside the character's exact silhouette is a flat, solid, uniform pure vivid MAGENTA (#FF00FF) chroma key background.
